title: Trap Liberation Army
summary: Really tight rhymes and the political lyrics remind me of so many who have come before. Laying these effectively over synth drums palying with the concept of long delay followed by a bit of snare... I really dig this album.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Source: https://simalee.bandcamp.com/

Really tight rhymes and the political lyrics remind me of so many who have come before. Laying these effectively over synth drums palying with the concept of long delay followed by a bit of snare...

I really dig this album.
